components.css: .ds-palette { width: 480px; border-radius: 22px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--glass-strong, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.8)); border: 0.5px solid var(--glass-edge, rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.5px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 24px 70px rgb(20 40 80 / 0.22), 0 4px 12px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08); backdrop-filter: blur(32px) saturate(190%); font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; color: rgb(0 0 0 / 0.87); } .ds-pal-search { height: 58px; display: flex; align-items: center; padding: 0 20px; border-bottom: 0.5px solid rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08); } .ds-pal-search input { flex: 1; border: 0; outline: 0; background: none; font: 400 18px/1 inherit; color: inherit; } .ds-pal-group { padding: 10px 20px 5px; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 600; color: rgb(60 60 67 / 0.76); } .ds-pal-row { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 30px 1fr auto; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 48px; margin: 0 8px; padding: 6px 12px 6px 10px; border-radius: 11px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-pal-row:hover { background: rgb(0 0 0 / 0.045); } .ds-pal-row.ds-on { background: var(--accent, #0071e3); color: white; } .ds-pal-ico { width: 30px; height: 30px; border-radius: 8px; background: rgb(120 120 128 / 0.08); } .ds-on .ds-pal-ico { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.2); } .ds-pal-t { display: block; font-size: 15px; font-weight: 590; letter-spacing: -0.012em; } .ds-pal-s { display: block; font-size: 12.5px; color: rgb(60 60 67 / 0.76); } .ds-on .ds-pal-s { color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.92); } .ds-kbd { display: inline-grid; place-items: center; min-width: 20px; height: 20px; padding: 0 5px; border-radius: 5px; font: 500 11px/1 inherit; background: rgb(120 120 128 / 0.08); box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 0.5px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.14); } .ds-on .ds-ret { background: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.2); color: white; box-shadow: none; }

components.name: Primary Capsule Button
components.description: Accent capsule for Send, Download and Approve.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 7px; height: 34px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--accent, #0071e3); color: white; font: 600 13.5px -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #0071e3) 30%, transparent); cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), filter 150ms; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { filter: brightness(1.07); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0071e3); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Fill Capsule Button

components.css: .ds-btn-fill { height: 32px; padding: 0 14px; border: 0; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--fill, rgb(120 120 128 / 0.14)); color: var(--ink, rgb(0 0 0 / 0.87)); font: 600 13px -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: transform 160ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } .ds-btn-fill:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, rgb(0 0 0 / 0.87) 14%, transparent); } .ds-btn-fill:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-btn-fill:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #0071e3); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: URL Capsule (sending)
components.description: 44px URL capsule with method badge and 34px Send; shows the Send pulse while in flight.
components.css: .ds-url { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 4px; width: 460px; height: 44px; padding: 0 5px 0 6px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--canvas-2, #f7f7f9); font-family: -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-method { height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 999px; background: rgb(120 120 128 / 0.08); color: #1d8a3a; font: 700 12px/1 ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; } .ds-addr { flex: 1; padding: 0 8px; font: 13px/1 ui-monospace, Menlo, monospace; color: #0062cc; } .ds-send { height: 34px; padding: 0 16px; display: grid; place-items: center; border-radius: 999px; background: rgb(120 120 128 / 0.14); font-weight: 600; font-size: 13px; } .ds-sending { animation: ds-ring 1.8s cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1) infinite; } .ds-sending::after { content: ""; position: absolute; inset: 0; border-radius: inherit; pointer-events: none; background: linear-gradient(90deg, transparent, color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #0071e3) 16%, transparent), transparent) no-repeat; background-size: 40% 100%; animation: ds-sweep 1.6s ease-in-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-ring { 0% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #0071e3) 45%, transparent); } 70%, 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 9px transparent; } } @keyframes ds-sweep { from { background-position: -70% 0; } to { background-position: 170% 0; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-sending, .ds-sending::after { animation: none; } .ds-sending { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #0071e3) 35%, transparent); } }

components.name: Glass Menu

components.css: .ds-menu { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 6px; width: 300px; border-radius: 12px; font: 14.5px -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; background: var(--glass-strong, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.8)); border: 0.5px solid rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08); box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.5px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 24px 70px rgb(20 40 80 / 0.22), 0 4px 12px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08); backdrop-filter: blur(30px) saturate(190%); } .ds-menu li { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; height: 32px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: 7px; } .ds-menu li:hover, .ds-menu li.ds-hit { background: var(--accent, #0071e3); color: white; } .ds-menu kbd { font: inherit; color: rgb(60 60 67 / 0.76); } .ds-menu li:hover kbd, .ds-menu .ds-hit kbd { color: rgb(255 255 255 / 0.85); } .ds-menu .ds-sep { height: 1px; margin: 6px 12px; padding: 0; background: rgb(0 0 0 / 0.14); } .ds-menu .ds-sep:hover { background: rgb(0 0 0 / 0.14); }

components.css: .ds-inst-group { width: 460px; padding: 6px; border-radius: 20px; background: var(--glass-strong, rgb(255 255 255 / 0.8)); box-shadow: 0 0 0 0.5px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.1), 0 24px 70px rgb(20 40 80 / 0.22), 0 4px 12px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.08); font-family: -apple-system, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-inst { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; min-height: 64px; padding: 8px 10px 8px 14px; border-radius: 14px; } .ds-detected { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--accent, #0071e3) 10%, transparent); } .ds-inst b { display: block; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-inst small { display: block; font-size: 13px; color: rgb(60 60 67 / 0.76); } .ds-dl { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 34px; padding: 0 14px; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--accent, #0071e3); color: white; font-size: 13.5px; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-dl-2 { background: rgb(120 120 128 / 0.14); color: rgb(0 0 0 / 0.87); } .ds-dl:hover { filter: brightness(1.05); } .ds-dl:active { transform: scale(0.96); }

narrative.overview: Native macOS, Liquid Glass era (macOS Tahoe). Tether should feel like an app Apple shipped, not a web page in a frame. The world contributes material, type, palette and density; layout, navigation and controls stay standard macOS patterns.
keyCharacteristics: Real vibrancy and floating glass over an opaque canvas
Neutral system materials plus one accent; HTTP method colours always beside their label
SF Pro for words, SF Mono only for code
A stepped pixel-art landscape: faint wallpaper in the app, the page ground on the site

rules.name: The Same Plane Rule
rules.body: The brand mark is the landscape's paper plane, redrawn at 2px pixels (22×14) in the accent color. It is the only logo.

rules.name: The Fixed Accent Rule
rules.body: The page uses accent #0071e3 for fills and `--link` for text. It never uses the visitor's system accent, and it never puts white text on the lighter #0a84ff.

dos: Do pair every colour with a text label (method name, status code).
Do move the pixel landscape only in hard steps (steps()), and stop it under prefers-reduced-motion.
Do let the accent be the only thing that moves while a request is in flight.
donts: Don't use emoji or Unicode glyphs as icons; Lucide at 13–16px, one stroke weight.
Don't use SF Mono outside code, URLs and keys.
